## Communication Service Providers

Monetize your network investment, create next level experiences for your customers, and explore new growth opportunities with our unified communications, contact centers, and advanced global network APIs.

![laptop showing vonage API developer center screenshot with illustration of a hand holding a smartphone with a verify icon over it](https://vonage.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=cover,width=510,quality=85,format=auto,sharpen=1/content/dam/vonage/us-en/brand/vonage-does-that-site/New-Brand-API_resize.png)

## Independent Software Vendors

Embed Vonage APIs or integrate your SaaS products with ours, to be sold independently or as add-ons.

![Image depicting Vonage solutions on mobile device and desktop](https://vonage.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=cover,width=510,quality=85,format=auto,sharpen=1/content/dam/vonage/us-en/unified-communications/landing-page-imagery/VonageSolutions.png)

## System Integrators

Offer deployment, integration, and managed services to your enterprise customers. Resell Vonage solutions or deliver referrals our way too.

## Channel Partners

Offer your small, mid-market, and enterprise customers a scalable, reliable, and affordable business communications solution.

![Shot of a group of young people using computers during a late night in a modern office](https://vonage.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=cover,width=510,quality=85,format=auto,sharpen=1/content/dam/vonage/es_es/us-en/resources/imagery/article-thumbnails/pr-02-20-2024b.png)

 VVIP

## Vonage Verified Implementation Partners

The Vonage Verified Implementation Partner Program (VVIP) gives qualified partners the ability to directly implement both Vonage Business Communications and Vonage Contact Center. VVIP also allows partners to have customer-approved administrative access to their customer accounts using their own native partner credentials.

Interested? Fill out the form and your Regional Channel Manager will contact you with more information.

![List of API partners](https://vonage.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=cover,width=680,quality=85,format=auto,sharpen=1/content/dam/vonage/us-en/api/imagery/3u-partners.png)

### Find a partner

Want to boost the power of your Vonage communications solutions? Explore add-ons, integrations, and services provided by Vonage and our trusted partners.

[Visit the Vonage Marketplace](https://vonage.com/marketplace/)
